title: Common
description: Types shared by several messages. Not a message itself.

seq.description: Sequence number of a message, counted by its sender per connection, starting at 1.

player_id.description: Opaque player identifier chosen by the server. Clients never interpret it.

tile.description: A tile of the room grid. The server checks that it lies inside the room.

player.description: A player in a room. path holds the tiles still to walk, if the player is moving.
